limitations: Regular integer-rate fixed-N schedule for one JVM/load slot only; no Poisson/fixed-duration/distributed scheduling or EC2 launcher.
Overload was controlled with held responses/driver pauses in a local model; TCP fixtures were small normal-load integration, not server capacity measurements.
collectionValid/scheduleQualified/serviceHealthy are distinct; overload accounting validity does not establish a lossless offered workload or service capacity.
Only phase-level lag summaries are implemented; latency histogram/percentiles/standard result export remain pending.
Observer callbacks must be nonblocking; deliberate pauses in negative fixtures test loss accounting, not realtime guarantees.
Raw/apply qualification remains local and conservative; unknown write effects do not pass replica drain qualification.
Original O00 RPC-per-socket transport/algorithms and prior recorded V07 intermittent issue remain unchanged; no failures in this final full run.
